note: OSV lists no fix commit; from the advisory and the 4.1.134 to 4.1.135 jar diff. The control characters before the request line are skipped in HttpObjectDecoder.skipControlCharacters (4.1.0) and LineParser.skipControlChars (4.1.100 on); 4.1.50 has neither helper, so LineParser.parse, the caller, is listed too and is present in 4.1.0, 4.1.50, 4.1.100, 4.1.131, 4.2.0 and 4.2.12. Every Netty HTTP/1 decoder runs this, so the record only clears services with no HTTP/1 codec.
